Use wording suitable for the fictional author's older sister.", "reference_date": "2027-02-01", "user_control": "continue", "clarifications": [], "field_values": {"audience": "Use wording suitable for the fictional author's older sister.", "tone": "The style should feel intimate and grateful.", "length": null, "required_content": "Use this fictional material: The dedication recalls an older sister keeping the spare chair beside her lamp and listening to every unfinished page.\nThe author thanks her with the words you waited.\nRequired wording, verbatim: \"the spare chair\", \"every unfinished page\", \"you waited\"."}, "eligible_fields": ["length"], "remaining_question_items": 3, "fields": [{"field_id": "audience", "label_zh": "受众", "description_zh": "目标读者或收件人。不得凭体裁猜测具体受众。", "question_template": "Who is the intended audience?"}, {"field_id": "tone", "label_zh": "语气", "description_zh": "语气或明确无偏好。缺省语气不视为已提供。", "question_template": "What tone would you like?"}, {"field_id": "length", "label_zh": "长度", "description_zh": "全文英文词数范围或明确无长度要求。", "question_template": "What word-count range should the full text follow?"}, {"field_id": "required_content", "label_zh": "必含内容", "description_zh": "用户明确要求的具体事实或逐字内容。仅有主题或体裁不算已提供；明确无必含内容则算已解决。", "question_template": "What information or exact wording must the text include?"}]}
